issue_request: FHIR-22622 asked whether the human-readable title in the mapping-language `map "..." = "..."` statement was a string or identifier. Later Published issue FHIR-27915 replaced the old `map` metadata statement with `/// name{.property}* = {value}` metadata syntax in commit c372919350db4764cebd887053bd3bd567234faa, removing the exact sentence FHIR-22622 changed. The formal grammar still preserves optional legacy `mapDeclaration`, and FHIR-27915 already has a combined-branch audit commit, so no duplicate related decision was published.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original request was applied historically, and the current authoritative source no longer contains the ambiguous wording that prompted FHIR-22622.
